$Comment: Bram the Shepherd's own small board: one job a day, drawn at midnight UTC. Hosts names the id Bram keeps
in both seasons (Harvest_Feast_Shepherd), so his quest page (in his Christmas conversation and in his
feast conversation's Christmas line) lists the day's job beside his own quests.
The first slot posts the Christmas_Shepherd_Skill band, which only his skill job carries
(Mmo_Christmas_Shepherd_Skill_Job.json, a server running MMO Skill Tree); the second posts the
Christmas_Shepherd_Errand band, his plain errands. The slot gates are read when the board loads: Min 1
leaves a slot off where MMO Skill Tree is missing, Max 0 where it is installed, so every server posts
one job from Bram a day for the same plain pay. Both slots are Optional, so the one a server leaves out
never reads as a gap. Christmas_Miller_Jobs.json explains the rest; its words are in
